doctrine.summary: The Islamic State grew out of al-Qaeda in Iraq, broke with al-Qaeda in 2014, and in 2014-2017 held a proto-state across Iraq and Syria with captured army armour, Humvees, MRAPs and mass use of vehicle-borne bombs. After losing Mosul (2017) and Baghouz (2019) it returned to a rural insurgency of small cells in the deserts and mountains of Anbar, Salahuddin, Kirkuk, Diyala, the Syrian Badia and Deir ez-Zor. In 2026 its Syria campaign grew: after the January 2026 government offensive in the north-east and the handover of SDF-run detention sites, IS declared a 'new phase' of operations, and attacks on Syrian government forces rose from 16 in 2025 to 52 in the first half of 2026 (AFP count), concentrated in Raqqa and Deir ez-Zor. Outside the core, its provinces include Sahel Province (Niger, Mali's Menaka, Burkina Faso; the January 2026 assault on Niamey airport), West Africa Province (Lake Chad) and Somalia Province (Puntland). This faction covers the core and the Sahel and Somalia provinces (Captain-confirmed 2026-10-10); Khorasan Province is its own faction (isis_k). In the game IS is the classic early-game desert-cell enemy, with rare captured army vehicles as set pieces.
doctrine.fireteam: Cells of 3-8 under a local 'wali' structure; raids of 10-30 in the Sahel. In game: 2-4 battle-buddy pairs, Sahel encounters bigger and on motorbikes.
tactics: Night raids from desert hideouts on checkpoints and villages, then dispersal into wadis

notes: The Islamic State is UN-listed and designated a terrorist organisation by nearly every state; the Global Coalition to Defeat ISIS (which Syria joined in November 2025) opposes it. Its current caliph, announced in August 2023 as Abu Hafs al-Hashimi al-Qurashi, has not been publicly identified. Status 2026: rising attacks in Syria after the January 2026 north-east fighting, escapes from detention sites and the US withdrawal from Syria; a June 2026 attack on Raqqa police headquarters; persistent low-level cells in Iraq where the ISF lead clearance operations. Sahel Province attacked Niamey airport (January 2026) and claimed attacks that killed more than 50 Nigerien troops (September 2026); it fights JNIM as well as the AES juntas and Africa Corps. Somalia Province, based in Puntland's Cal Miskaad mountains, was the target of a major Puntland offensive in 2025. Captured 2014-2017 Humvees, M1117s and T-55s appear only as rare set pieces (Captain-confirmed (2026-10-10)). Affiliate link: isis_k (+90). Rival: the al-Qaeda network (al_qaeda, aqap, al_shabaab, jnim), all strongly negative. Covering the Sahel and Somalia provinces in this faction (theatres sahel and horn_of_africa) is Captain-confirmed (2026-10-10). Job 7 (Captain, 2026-10-10): isis also covers the Islamic State's East Asia cells in the southern Philippines (theatre mindanao_sulu): Dawlah Islamiyah factions in Lanao del Sur and Maguindanao and the pro-IS remnants of the Abu Sayyaf, much reduced since the 2017 Marawi siege (Sulu was declared Abu Sayyaf-free in 2023) but still clashing with the army in 2026 (e.g. Lanao del Sur, April 2026; Maguindanao del Sur, June 2026), and IS remnant cells in the Hamrin hills and Diyala borderlands of Iraq (theatre iraq_iran_border). Its East Asia cells use pump boats and speedboats (fast_boat).
